text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing with topic sentences and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"Controls structure more effectively by grouping ideas into coherent paragraphs with an introduction, body, and conclusion."},{"evidence":"\"Here are some reasons why I would like to visit this place\" and repeated transitions like \"First,\" \"Secondly,\" \"Lastly\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"Uses clearer linking language to connect ideas and guide the reader through the essay."},{"evidence":"specific examples such as \"Aladdin park,\" \"Sea view,\" and \"Safari Park\"","quality":"concrete development","description":"Supports ideas with more specific, detailed examples rather than broad general statements."},{"evidence":"\"The rides are exhilarating\" and \"Pakistani cuisine is very delicious\"","quality":"descriptive language","description":"Uses more vivid word choice and sensory detail to make the writing more engaging."},{"evidence":"generally understandable sentences with fewer severe errors","quality":"grammatical control","description":"Shows stronger control of sentence formation and grammar, making the meaning easier to follow."}]}
